reason: Repository describes a DSH web client plugin that adds an on-screen sticky-note interface, including draggable/resizable notes and a sidebar entry; evidence also states notes are kept in browser localStorage with conversation binding, indicating its purpose is a UI utility for local note capture and organization rather than automation or external integration.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端插件，提供可拖拽缩放的便签界面，支持文字与图片便签、折叠归档，并可按会话在浏览器本地保存记录。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness Web client plugin that adds a floating sticky-note interface with markdown and image notes, supports collapse/archive actions, and stores notes per conversation in browser local storage.

capabilities: Stores notes, preferences, and settings in browser localStorage
Renders floating/resizable floating notes within the web UI
Supports markdown and image note content
Allows notes to be bound to individual conversations and archived/hidden
